messages.content:
Hi 
As per previous notes, there seems to be confusion as to which mpan you want us to register  - Mpan 2380000735300 - we have never held the supply, and any ET request or re-registration request would need to be sent to British Gas  -  Mpan 2345912765510 -  due to the age of this supply we are unwilling to accept an ET. If the customer wants to return to us they can do so through a natural registration or contact our customer service team - 0330 111 5050 - help@so.energy. 
Thank you
Mel

Hi just to re-iterate, we would be the ones that are refunding the customer, they haven't been paying you guys, hence were wanting the ET accepted so we can process this and remove their massive outstanding balance.

Hi 
If the customer has been paying for electricity that is not there supply, please ask them to contact us with proof of payments and proof of address, as we would need to trace the payments made to be able to refund

Hi Team, 
Customer cannot switch in via normal route as it is not their supply. They switched in the wrong supply initially and should not be paying for electricity they did not use. Please accept the ET.

Hi, due to the age of this supply we are unwilling to accept an ET. If the customer wants to return to us they can do so through a natural registration or contact our customer service team - 0330 111 5050 - help@so.energy. Thank you

Hello customer whos actual address which is under this MPAN : 2380000735300 has been paying for this persons MPAN: 2345912765510 for two years. can we have the person with the MPan ending in 300 re-registered please.

Hi, we don't currently have a customer linked to this address, could you please confirm the address for the MPAN you're returning and the intended property you were meant to take so we can fully investigate
Please re-register this customer ASAP. They were paying bills for another property for 2 years. Their real MPAN is 2380000735300, addresses mismatch by 1 digit
